note: Average comminution energy per tonne of copper product (printed 1134 kW h/t). Comminution only (SAG/ball milling complete; crushing and fine grinding only partly surveyed); mill power at 96% average utilisation of installed power; energy per unit of FINAL METAL product, not per tonne of ore, so it includes the ore-grade effect. Survey of 68 mines (JKTech surveys 1992-2012, production data 2007-2012), heavily weighted to Australia. Electricity: heating-value basis not applicable.
